papers.title: Integrated MCNP Reliability Diagnosis Framework using Data-Driven Pattern Analysis and Physics-Informed Neural Network
papers.venue: Journal of Korean institute of intelligent systems

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文将PINN用于核工程MCNP可靠性诊断，与FEA代理建模方向仅有方法层面的松散关联。
llm.why_not_core: It applies PINN to nuclear Monte Carlo reliability diagnosis with no FEA surrogate benchmarking, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, and no constraint-handling or UQ evaluation relevant to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 核工程MCNP仿真计算昂贵，需高效可靠性诊断手段。
summary_zh.method: 结合数据驱动模式分析与物理信息神经网络构建可靠性诊断框架。
summary_zh.result: 在MCNP算例上实现可靠性模式识别与诊断。
summary_zh.validation: 基于核工程仿真算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Monte Carlo transport simulations such as MCNP are computationally expensive, motivating more efficient reliability diagnosis.
summary_en.method: A framework combining data-driven pattern analysis with a physics-informed neural network is proposed for reliability diagnosis.
summary_en.result: The framework identifies reliability patterns and performs diagnosis on MCNP simulation cases.
summary_en.validation: Validated on nuclear engineering simulation cases rather than experimental or biomechanical data.

papers.title: Advanced nonlinear model predictive control for electric vehicle battery thermal management under the Addis Ababa Bishoftu driving cycle
concepts: Thermal management of electronic devices and systems

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究电动汽车电池热管理的非线性模型预测控制，与强化学习/世界模型及工程仿真代理建模方向基本无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a control-theory application for EV battery thermal management with no model-based RL, world model, surrogate modeling, FEA, or biomechanics/implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电动汽车电池在真实驾驶循环下的热管理控制问题。
summary_zh.method: 采用非线性模型预测控制策略调节电池热状态。
summary_zh.result: 在Addis Ababa Bishoftu驾驶循环下评估控制性能。
summary_zh.validation: 基于驾驶循环的仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to improve battery thermal regulation for electric vehicles under realistic driving conditions.
summary_en.method: A nonlinear model predictive control scheme is formulated to manage battery thermal behavior.
summary_en.result: Controller performance is assessed over the Addis Ababa Bishoftu driving cycle.
summary_en.validation: Validation relies on simulation of a specific driving-cycle scenario.

papers.title: Active Learning Enables Discovery of Asymmetric Dual-Atom Catalysts for Nitrate-to-Ammonia Electrocatalysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Electrochemical nitrate reduction to ammonia requires a delicate balance between nitrate activation, hydrogen delivery, suppression of competing hydrogen evolution, and stabilization of the catalytic metal centers. Such coupled requirements make the rational design of dual-atom catalysts challenging, particularly when the two metal sites and their coordination environments contribute differently to the reaction. Here, we establish an interpretable active-learning framework to navigate the chemical space of asymmetric dual-atom catalysts and uncover the physicochemical origins of their performance. Rather than learning an empirical activity score, the framework predicts individual DFT-derived properties from readily accessible elemental and structural descriptors and uses uncertainty-aware sampling to iteratively explore previously uncharted metal-pair and coordination environments. Model interpretation reveals distinct roles of the two metal sites in regulating nitrate activation and hydrogen adsorption, and identifies moderate electronic asymmetry coupled with mixed N/O coordination as a favorable design regime. Guided by these principles, active learning efficiently explores an expanded library of 1050 structures and progressively identifies candidates beyond the initial chemical space. Prospective DFT validation highlights Mo–Ta/N3O3–C, Mo–Nb/N3O3–C, and Mo–Nb/N5O1–C as promising catalysts, whose performance arises from a balanced combination of reaction thermodynamics, adsorption selectivity, and structural stability. These findings establish a transferable strategy for designing multifunctional dual-atom sites and demonstrate how interpretable, closed-loop learning can transform catalyst screening from property prediction into mechanism-guided materials discovery.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的主动学习+不确定性采样框架与FEA代理模型采样效率问题有方法学关联，但应用领域为电催化材料发现，与植入物/生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This work applies active learning to DFT catalyst screening for electrocatalysis, with no FEA, no surrogate modeling of solid mechanics, no implant/biomechanics context, and no contact or stress analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 双原子催化剂设计需平衡多个耦合要求，化学空间探索成本高。
summary_zh.method: 构建可解释主动学习框架，从元素与结构描述符预测DFT性质，并用不确定性采样迭代探索。
summary_zh.result: 识别出Mo–Ta/N3O3–C等候选催化剂，揭示电子不对称性与混合配位有利区间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过前瞻性DFT计算验证候选结构。

summary_en.motivation: Rational design of asymmetric dual-atom catalysts is hindered by coupled reactivity requirements and a vast chemical space.
summary_en.method: An interpretable active-learning framework predicts individual DFT-derived properties from elemental and structural descriptors and uses uncertainty-aware sampling to iteratively expand the explored metal-pair and coordination space.
summary_en.result: The framework identifies moderate electronic asymmetry with mixed N/O coordination as favorable and proposes several Mo-based candidates validated by DFT.
summary_en.validation: Prospective DFT calculations confirm the predicted promising catalysts.
